claude.rationale: gap_45 = 0: Alon's product/asset tier (Big Spring and Krotz Springs refineries, associated wholesale marketing, ~300 convenience stores) crossed into HoldCo whole via the reverse-triangular merger with Alon surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary, so the productive/operating refinery assets and their operations moved together — there is no documented product-vs-process split at closing. gap_56 = 1: the operating assets/processes transferred, but "all of Alon's then-serving officers were removed" and its entire board was replaced except two prior Delek appointees, so the people/management tier (T6) did not transfer or align coherently alongside the processes. gap_mitigated = no: the slice states "No transition-services, shared-services, or supply-bridging agreement between Alon and any retained management entity was identified," so the T5/T6 gap was not contractually absorbed at closing.

gemini.rationale: The transaction transferred Alon's refineries and retail stores (T4) along with their operational processes (T5) intact, so there is no gap_45. However, at closing, all of Alon's then-serving officers and directors (except two Delek appointees) were removed and replaced, triggering change-in-control severance, with no transition-services agreement identified. This creates a gap_56, as the operational processes transferred without the executive management team that ran them.

grok.rationale: gap_45=0 because the slice shows Alon’s customer-facing assets (Krotz Springs and Big Spring refineries, wholesale marketing, California assets, and ~300 convenience stores) crossing into the HoldCo structure together with the refining/marketing business as a whole, with no documented product-vs-process separation at closing. gap_56=1 because at the effective time all Alon officers were removed, its board ceased (except pre-existing Delek appointees), change-in-control severance was triggered, and the joint proxy expressly identifies no transition-services, shared-services, or supply-bridging agreement allocating operating substrate.
